title: Clockwork Tithe
pitch: Every 60 seconds the Great Clock demands a tithe: pay with hoarded loot, a pillar of your strength, or your own blood — or refuse, and time freezes while your foes grow terrible until you pay double.
howto: Fight clockwork creatures and hoard the tithe-fodder they drop. When the clock strikes, choose what to surrender — fodder, a weakened stat, or raw HP — or refuse and defy a monochrome world of empowered foes until you settle the doubled debt. Every run earns Covenant Marks for permanent upgrades, and the Ledger remembers everything you ever tithed.
controls: Drag anywhere to move — your knight fires on his own. Tap the big choices when the clock strikes. WASD works on desktop.
